name: Task_3
description:
Generate a reference dataset for fine-tuning the MACE-MP-0b machine learning interatomic potential for a diatomic Ag₂ system. First, generate a dataset of Ag₂ configurations using an interatomic-distance grid spanning from 0.6 Å to 5.0 Å with a uniform spacing of 0.1 Å. Use the base MACE-MP foundation model as an ASE calculator to compute the potential energies and forces for all configurations, and store these as proxy labels.

Use 45 isolated, nonperiodic dimers and the supplied teacher.model (MACE-MP-0) with dispersion enabled. Retain total energies in eV and complete atomic forces in eV/Å, and submit the labeled dataset.
